sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的蕾切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In the growing conflict between Israel and Iran, one question now looms over Washington.
sentences.zh: 在以色列和伊朗不断升级的冲突中，现在有一个问题笼罩着华盛顿。

sentences.en: How far will President Trump go to entangle the United States in a new war?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统会走多远，把美国卷入一场新的战争？

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jonathan Swan on Trump's shifting stance on U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事乔纳森·斯旺将探讨特朗普对美国介入立场的转变

sentences.en: involvement and the options that he is now weighing.
sentences.zh: 以及他目前正在权衡的选项。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月18日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jonathan, we're talking to you at about 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，我们是在周二下午4点左右

sentences.en: Eastern on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 美东时间采访你的。

sentences.en: And as of now, there's growing evidence that President Trump is seriously considering joining Israel's bombing campaign in Iran.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，越来越多的迹象表明，特朗普总统正严肃考虑加入以色列对伊朗的轰炸行动。

sentences.en: Which, that's something that Trump has said, long said, that he has not wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 而这，是特朗普长期以来一直表示他不想做的事。

sentences.en: He has been very opposed to pulling the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他一直非常反对把美国

sentences.en: into more war.
sentences.zh: 拖入更多的战争。

sentences.en: So, can you just explain to start us off, how and why has Trump's position on this shifted?
sentences.zh: 所以，能不能先给我们解释一下，特朗普在这个问题上的立场是如何以及为什么发生转变的？

sentences.en: Look, it's not a simple story.
sentences.zh: 听着，这不是一个简单的故事。

sentences.en: It took place over a period of months.
sentences.zh: 这是在几个月的时间里发生的。

sentences.en: And yes, it's true Donald Trump said, I'm not going to get you into another endless war,
sentences.zh: 没错，唐纳德·特朗普确实说过：“我不会把你们带入另一场无休止的战争，

sentences.en: Middle East war.
sentences.zh: 中东战争。”

sentences.en: But he's also said consistently that Iran cannot be allowed to have a nuclear bomb.
sentences.zh: 但他也一贯表示，绝不能容许伊朗拥有核弹。

sentences.en: So, basically, what happened was Donald Trump leaves office in January 2021.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上发生的情况是，唐纳德·特朗普在2021年1月卸任。

sentences.en: And according to the Justice Department, the Iranian government hired hitmen to kill Donald
sentences.zh: 根据司法部的说法，伊朗政府雇用了杀手来谋杀唐纳德

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: People forget that.
sentences.zh: 人们都忘了这一点。

sentences.en: This was revenge for, supposedly, for his killing of a top Iranian general in early 2020.
sentences.zh: 这据说是为了报复他在2020年初刺杀了一名伊朗高级将领。

sentences.en: And the Iranians also hack the emails of some of his top aides, including his now chief of staff, Susie Wiles.
sentences.zh: 而且伊朗还黑了其一些高级助手（包括他现在的幕僚长苏西·怀尔斯）的电子邮箱。

sentences.en: Iran, of course, denies all of this.
sentences.zh: 当然，伊朗否认了所有这一切。

sentences.en: But this created a conventional wisdom that God help Iran if Donald Trump gets elected again, because he will rain fury upon them.
sentences.zh: 但这造成了一种共识：如果唐纳德·特朗普再次当选，上帝会保佑伊朗，因为他将对他们降下狂怒。

sentences.en: And from the Israeli perspective, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, for a long time, has wanted to undertake a military operation to take out Iran's nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 从以色列的角度来看，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直想要采取军事行动来摧毁伊朗的核计划。

sentences.en: And in his first term, Donald Trump gave Netanyahu virtually everything he wanted.
sentences.zh: 在他的第一个任期内，唐纳德·特朗普几乎满足了内塔尼亚胡的所有要求。

sentences.en: So, it was this confluence of events.
sentences.zh: 所以，正是这些事件交织在了一起。

sentences.en: You had Trump returning to the White House, supposedly filled with desire for vengeance.
sentences.zh: 你看到特朗普重返白宫，心中据信充满了复仇的渴望。

sentences.en: And then you had Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 然后你又有了内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: And now he had, the thinking went, a president who was going to be more full-throated in support of this Israeli policy.
sentences.zh: 当时的普遍看法是，现在有了一位会更坚定支持这一以色列政策的总统。

sentences.en: But that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: When Trump got into office, one of the first things he did was he empowered Steve Witkoff,
sentences.zh: 特朗普上任后，做的第一件事就是赋权史蒂夫·维特科夫，

sentences.en: who is a billionaire, real estate developer, friends with Trump for many years, no experience in foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 他是一位亿万富翁、房地产开发商、特朗普多年的朋友，没有任何外交政策经验。

sentences.en: Trump appointed him special envoy to the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 特朗普任命他为中东问题特使。

sentences.en: And pretty early in the administration, Trump said to him, I want you to try to get a deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 在政府上台之初，特朗普就对他说，我希望你尝试与伊朗达成协议。

sentences.en: I don't want to go to war.
sentences.zh: 我不想打仗。

sentences.en: He wanted diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 他想要外交手段。

sentences.en: A hundred percent he wanted diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，他想要外交解决。

sentences.en: There's this BS kind of revisionist history going on right now.
sentences.zh: 现在正流传着一种扯淡的修正主义历史。

sentences.en: You see it sort of seeping out in kind of like anonymous officials and stuff, you know, from
sentences.zh: 你可以看到它从某些匿名官员等渠道渗透出来，你知道的，

sentences.en: Israel or some here saying, this was all a brilliant ruse.
sentences.zh: 来自以色列或者这里的一些人说，这一切都是一个高明的计谋。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was in on it all along.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普一直都参与其中。

sentences.en: He was pretending to be interested in diplomacy, but really he was always supportive of this effort.
sentences.zh: 他假装对外交感兴趣，但实际上他一直支持这项努力。

sentences.en: Total nonsense.
sentences.zh: 纯属无稽之谈。

sentences.en: Trump was really serious about getting a deal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是真心实意想要达成协议的。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Donald Trump was very clear with his advisors early on in the administration.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，唐纳德·特朗普在政府初期对他的顾问们非常明确。

sentences.en: He did not trust Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 他不信任本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: He thought that Netanyahu was trying to drag him into a war on Netanyahu's timeline.
sentences.zh: 他认为内塔尼亚胡正试图按照内塔尼亚胡的时间表把他拖入战争。

sentences.en: Trump wanted to be given the space and time to try to find a diplomatic solution because in his view, that is preferable to war.
sentences.zh: 特朗普希望获得空间和时间去寻找外交解决方案，因为在他看来，这总比战争好。

sentences.en: But his baseline was actually always the same, which is Iran can't have a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 但他的底线其实一直没变，那就是伊朗不能拥有核武器。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So really what you had was this dual track.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上你看到的是双轨并行。

sentences.en: You had Trump authorizing his team to pursue diplomacy, but Netanyahu determined to go ahead with a military operation.
sentences.zh: 一方面特朗普授权他的团队寻求外交途径，另一方面内塔尼亚胡则决心推进军事行动。

sentences.en: And when you talk to people around Trump, it was always a case of trying to hold Netanyahu at bay for long enough to try to get to a deal.
sentences.zh: 当你与特朗普身边的人交谈时，情况总是设法牵制内塔尼亚胡足够长的时间，以争取达成协议。

sentences.en: So tell me more about what Netanyahu is up to while Trump is pursuing this diplomatic path.
sentences.zh: 那么，请告诉我更多关于当特朗普追求外交途径时，内塔尼亚胡在搞什么鬼。

sentences.en: Well, Netanyahu is, of course, dealing with a war in Gaza, and he's going after Iran's proxies in the region, including in Lebanon, where exploding pages killed scores of Hezbollah
sentences.zh: 嗯，内塔尼亚胡当然在应对加沙的战争，他正在打击伊朗在该地区的代理人，包括在黎巴嫩，那里的传呼机爆炸导致数十名真主党

sentences.en: operatives and wounded thousands.
sentences.zh: 特工丧生，数千人受伤。

sentences.en: And then in early February, Netanyahu makes his first visit to the Trump White House in the second term.
sentences.zh: 然后是在2月上旬，内塔尼亚胡对特朗普的第二任期白宫进行了首次访问。

sentences.en: And he's clearly thought very carefully about what to say to Trump to persuade him to get on board with this military mission to take out Iran's nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 他显然经过深思熟虑，思考该对特朗普说些什么，以说服他支持旨在摧毁伊朗核计划的军事任务。

sentences.en: So he brings along with him a gift for Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，他随身带了一件给特朗普的礼物。

sentences.en: And it's a gold-plated pager, the same device that Israel secretly packed with explosives and sold to unwitting Hezbollah operatives.
sentences.zh: 这是一个镀金的寻呼机，也就是以色列秘密装满炸药并卖给不知情的真主党特工的那种设备。

sentences.en: So he's like commemorating this attack with this gift.
sentences.zh: 所以他送这个礼物就像是在纪念这次袭击。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Trump was kind of weirded out by it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对这东西感到有点怪异。

sentences.en: He like told someone afterwards that he thought it was just really weird and kind of disturbing.
sentences.zh: 事后他曾对人说，他觉得这东西真的很怪异，而且有点让人不安。

sentences.en: But in that meeting in the Oval Office, Netanyahu walks Trump through a visual presentation, a slide presentation of Iran's nuclear sites.
sentences.zh: 但在椭圆形办公室的那次会面中，内塔尼亚胡向特朗普展示了一场幻灯片演示，内容是伊朗的核设施。

sentences.en: And he's starting this argument that time is short.
sentences.zh: 他开始阐述一个观点，那就是时间紧迫。

sentences.en: We have this historic window, this historic opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个历史性的窗口，一个历史性的机遇。

sentences.en: Iran's air defenses have been battered.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的防空系统已经遭到重创。

sentences.en: We have them where we want them.
sentences.zh: 我们已经把他们拿捏住了。

sentences.en: This proxy force, Hezbollah, was decimated.
sentences.zh: 这个代理人武装真主党已经被消灭了大半。

sentences.en: So now is the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以现在就是时机。

sentences.en: And with that, he is hoping that the US will join them in a mission.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他希望美国能加入他们的行动。

sentences.en: There's not like one simple ask.
sentences.zh: 并不是说只有一个简单的诉求。

sentences.en: There's a whole range of things that the United States could do from covert support and intelligence to things that Israel doesn't have the capabilities to do.
sentences.zh: 美国可以做的事情有很多，从暗中支持和情报援助，到以色列自身不具备能力去做的事情。

sentences.en: So for example, you have bunker-busting bombs that weighed 30,000 pounds that would be needed to destroy a nuclear site named Fordow deep underground.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，摧毁位于地底深处的福尔多核设施需要用到重达3万磅的钻地弹。

sentences.en: The US has these bombs.
sentences.zh: 美国拥有这种炸弹。

sentences.en: Israel doesn't.
sentences.zh: 以色列没有。

sentences.en: So one of Netanyahu's objectives was to try to convince Trump to provide these weapons to go after Iran.
sentences.zh: 因此，内塔尼亚胡的目标之一就是试图说服特朗普提供这些武器来对付伊朗。

sentences.en: But he failed in that moment.
sentences.zh: 但他在当时失败了。

sentences.en: What do you mean he failed?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思，他失败了？

sentences.en: How does Trump respond to this?
sentences.zh: 特朗普是怎么回应的？

sentences.en: Well, Trump sends him home empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普让他空手而归。

sentences.en: He's not ready to give him the bombs.
sentences.zh: 他还没准备好把炸弹给他。

sentences.en: He's not ready to commit to America doing a joint mission with Israel.
sentences.zh: 他还没准备好承诺让美国与以色列开展联合军事行动。

sentences.en: He says, we are going to try diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们要尝试通过外交途径解决。

sentences.en: We're going to try to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 我们要试着达成一项协议。

sentences.en: And that's the method we're using.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在采用的方法。

sentences.en: So it sounds like at this moment in time that you've described, Netanyahu and Trump have at least one
sentences.zh: 听起来在你描述的这个时间点上，内塔尼亚胡和特朗普至少有一个

sentences.en: goal that is the same, which is that neither of them want to allow Iran to get a nuclear weapon, but they disagree on the means to achieve that end.
sentences.zh: 相同的目标，那就是他们都不想让伊朗拥核，但他们在实现这一目标的手段上存在分歧。

sentences.en: Trump wants diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普想要外交手段。

sentences.en: Netanyahu wants force.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡想要诉诸武力。

sentences.en: What happens after this meeting?
sentences.zh: 这次会面之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, after this meeting, Trump starts to put out feelers to Iran.
sentences.zh: 嗯，会面结束后，特朗普开始向伊朗抛出橄榄枝。

sentences.en: And Iran had already put out its own feelers to the US.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗此前就已经向美国释放过信号了。

sentences.en: So about half a dozen countries or so were sending messages.
sentences.zh: 当时大约有六个左右的国家在传话。

sentences.en: The
sentences.zh: 这

sentences.en: Iranians are interested in talking, back channels, all that kind of stuff, including the Omanis, who often play that role.
sentences.zh: 些伊朗人表现出对话的兴趣，通过暗中渠道等等，其中包括经常扮演这一角色的阿曼人。

sentences.en: But Trump himself decides to send a letter to the Ayatollah.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普本人决定给最高领袖写一封信。

sentences.en: Is that unusual?
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's very Trumpian.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这非常符合特朗普的作风。

sentences.en: You know, it recalls his letters to Kim Jong-un of North Korea in his first term.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这让人想起他在第一个任期内写给朝鲜最高领导人金正恩的信。

sentences.en: So in early March, a source of mine, you know, sees Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以在3月初，我的一个消息源见到了特朗普。

sentences.en: And Trump's new kind of thing at that moment was he would wave around this letter that he'd sent to the Ayatollah.
sentences.zh: 当时特朗普的新爱好就是到处挥舞他写给最高领袖的那封信。

sentences.en: Like a copy of it?
sentences.zh: 就像是一份复印件？

sentences.en: It was a copy of it.
sentences.zh: 确实是一份复印件。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And he'd say, I wrote the most beautiful letter to the Ayatollah.
sentences.zh: 他会说，我给最高领袖写了一封最漂亮的信。

sentences.en: Do you want to hear about it?
sentences.zh: 你想听听吗？

sentences.en: And he would give these like live renditions of the letter.
sentences.zh: 然后他会现场声情并茂地朗诵这封信的内容。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What did the letter say?
sentences.zh: 信里都写了些什么？

sentences.en: I have not seen the letter, but one visitor who was treated to one of these live renditions told me the letter's basic message was, I don't want war.
sentences.zh: 我没看过这封信，但一位有幸听到这种现场朗诵的访客告诉我，这封信的核心信息是：我不想要战争。

sentences.en: I don't want to blow you off the map.
sentences.zh: 我不想把你从地图上抹去。

sentences.en: I want a deal.
sentences.zh: 我想要达成协议。

sentences.en: So very classic Trump message, which is, you know, I want diplomacy, but also I might remind you that I could completely annihilate you.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常典型的特朗普式的信息，也就是，你知道的，我想要外交解决，但我也得提醒你，我有能力彻底消灭你。

sentences.en: Not subtle stuff.
sentences.zh: 一点也不委婉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that happens.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: So that's March, April, the negotiations start.
sentences.zh: 到了三四月份，谈判开始了。

sentences.en: So Steve Whitcoff and the director of policy planning at the State Department, Michael Anton, they go over to Oman and they start these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·维特科夫和国务院政策规划主任迈克尔·安顿前往阿曼，开始了这些谈判。

sentences.en: And, you know, they spend hours and hours over a number of different rounds over a couple of months negotiating with the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在几个月的时间里进行了多轮谈判，花了无数个小时与伊朗人交涉。

sentences.en: What could you live with?
sentences.zh: 你们能接受什么底线？

sentences.en: What could you not live with?
sentences.zh: 你们绝对不能接受什么？

sentences.en: And finally, at the end of May, the US side actually presents a proposal, a written proposal that says that ultimately there can be no enrichment, but here are these ideas for
sentences.zh: 最后，在5月底，美方实际上提出了一份提案，一份书面提案，上面说最终不能进行铀浓缩，但这里有一些关于

sentences.en: how you can have civilian nuclear power.
sentences.zh: 如何发展民用核能的想法。

sentences.en: And Steve Whitcoff was telling Trump, we're on the cusp of a deal.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·维特科夫当时对特朗普说，我们马上就要达成协议了。

sentences.en: For a while, Trump was saying, I think we're doing better with Iran than we are with Russia.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，特朗普一直在说，我觉得我们跟伊朗的进展比跟俄罗斯的进展还要顺利。

sentences.en: I really want a deal.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想达成协议。

sentences.en: They're really weak, etc., etc.
sentences.zh: 他们现在真的很虚弱，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Jonathan, while these talks are happening, and it looks at least for a time like the US and Iran are inching closer to a deal.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，正当这些谈判在进行，而且至少有一段时间看起来美国和伊朗正一步步接近达成协议时，

sentences.en: How does Netanyahu feel about all of this and the negotiations?
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡对这一切以及这些谈判作何感想？

sentences.en: Not good.
sentences.zh: 感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: He comes in visits in early April, comes to Washington.
sentences.zh: 他在4月初前来访问，来到了华盛顿。

sentences.en: And that was not a good visit.
sentences.zh: 那可不是一次愉快的访问。

sentences.en: He again reiterated they want to get the bunker busting bomb.
sentences.zh: 他再次重申，他们想要拿到掩体钻地弹。

sentences.en: But Trump is very clear.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普态度非常明确。

sentences.en: No, you are to do nothing while we're still negotiating.
sentences.zh: 不，在我们还在谈判时，你们什么都不能做。

sentences.en: And after that meeting, Trump's entire team reinforced that message to the Israelis.
sentences.zh: 在那次会议之后，特朗普的整个团队向以色列人再次强调了这一信息。

sentences.en: Don't do it.
sentences.zh: 不要这么做。

sentences.en: Don't do it.
sentences.zh: 不要这么做。

sentences.en: And did the US officials who were saying that feel like they were being listened to or that Israel would do what they said?
sentences.zh: 那么，说这番话的美国官员觉得自己的话被听进去了吗？或者说他们觉得以色列会按他们说的做吗？

sentences.en: At the time, they did.
sentences.zh: 当时，他们是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: They think, well, the US, the Trump team thinks, well, I think they got the message.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，呃，美国，特朗普团队认为，呃，我觉得他们收到信号了。

sentences.en: But in May, the US intelligence community picks up intelligence showing that it's highly likely that Netanyahu is going to strike Iran with or without American support.
sentences.zh: 但在五月，美国情报界收集到情报，显示内塔尼亚威极有可能在有或没有美国支持的情况下对伊朗发动打击。

sentences.en: And this was a very unwelcome
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常不受欢迎的

sentences.en: discovery.
sentences.zh: 发现。

sentences.en: I mean, discovery is probably too strong a word because they knew how badly he wanted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，“发现”这个词可能有点严重，因为他们很清楚他有多渴望这么做。

sentences.en: This is not some surprise.
sentences.zh: 这并不是什么意外。

sentences.en: But the clarity of, oh, he's really going to do this, really, really dawned upon them.
sentences.zh: 但那种“哦，他真的要这么做”的清晰感，确实、确实让他们意识到了。

sentences.en: And what is the this here?
sentences.zh: 这里的“这个”指的是什么？

sentences.en: Like, what is the extent of the attack that they're learning about?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们了解到的这次袭击规模有多大？

sentences.en: Well, it was quite expansive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，规模相当广泛。

sentences.en: So it wasn't just an attack that would, you know, be narrowly targeted at this facility or that facility.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是一场，你知道的，精准针对这个设施或那个设施的袭击。

sentences.en: It was an attack that could potentially imperil the regime itself.
sentences.zh: 而是一场可能会危及政权本身的袭击。

sentences.en: But as you've been saying, Jonathan, these are not new goals for Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 但正如你一直所说的那样，乔纳森，这些对内塔尼亚威来说并不是什么新目标。

sentences.en: So I'm just sort of wondering why he's choosing now.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点好奇他为什么偏偏选择现在动手。

sentences.en: Well, the Israelis say that Iran is on the cusp of having a nuclear bomb.
sentences.zh: 嗯，以色列人称伊朗正处于拥有核弹的边缘。

sentences.en: We, in all of our conversations with senior Trump administration officials, found that they were unaware of any new piece of
sentences.zh: 我们在与特朗普政府高级官员的所有对话中，发现他们并不知道有任何新的

sentences.en: intelligence showing that the Iranians were rushing to build a nuclear bomb.
sentences.zh: 情报显示伊朗人在争分夺秒地制造核弹。

sentences.en: So we did not find evidence on the US side to support that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在美国方面没有找到支持这一说法的证据。

sentences.en: But there are a number of people at the senior level of the Trump administration who nonetheless believe that Iran is too close for comfort to being able to get to
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府高层中有不少人仍然认为，伊朗距离获得

sentences.en: a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 核武器已经近在咫尺。

sentences.en: Regardless, once this information came through, once they had this intelligence that Israel was very likely to move ahead with an attack, the Trump team had a
sentences.zh: 无论如何，一旦这个消息传过来，一旦他们掌握了以色列极有可能推进袭击的情报，特朗普团队就进行了

sentences.en: conversation and they basically said, if this is going to happen, if this is very likely to happen, we need to be prepared.
sentences.zh: 一次交谈，他们基本上表示，如果事情真的要发生，如果这极有可能发生，我们必须做好准备。

sentences.en: So they explore a range of options from what can we do to restrain Netanyahu, all the way up to full-throated American military participation in a regime change war.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们探讨了一系列选项，从我们能做些什么来遏制内塔尼亚威，一直到全面支持美国军事参与一场旨在政权更迭的战争。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So that's all happening.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都在发生。

sentences.en: But meanwhile, Trump is getting really frustrated with the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，特朗普对伊朗人越来越感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: He keeps saying, take the deal.
sentences.zh: 他一直说，接受协议吧。

sentences.en: It was almost like they weren't understanding that his threat was real.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们好像根本不明白他的威胁是认真的。

sentences.en: And then two Fridays ago, I was on Air Force One with President Trump flying from
sentences.zh: 然后是两周前的周五，我正和特朗普总统乘坐空军一号从

sentences.en: Washington to New Jersey because he was spending the weekend at his golf club in Bedminster.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿飞往新泽西，因为他要在贝德明斯特的高尔夫俱乐部度过周末。

sentences.en: And the Ayatollah had made a comment during the week, which basically, it was really rejecting the
sentences.zh: 阿亚图拉在周中发表了一番评论，基本上，这实际上是拒绝了

sentences.en: Trump team's proposal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普团队的提议。

sentences.en: It was saying, we are going to have enrichment.
sentences.zh: 它在说，我们要进行浓缩铀活动。

sentences.en: We must have enrichment.
sentences.zh: 我们必须进行浓缩铀活动。

sentences.en: So I asked Trump on the plane about this.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在飞机上问了特朗普这件事。

sentences.en: I said, what did you make of, you know, the Ayatollah saying this?
sentences.zh: 我说，你怎么看待，你知道的，阿亚图拉说的话？

sentences.en: And he was adamant.
sentences.zh: 他态度非常坚决。

sentences.en: No enrichment.
sentences.zh: 绝对不进行浓缩铀活动。

sentences.en: We're not having it.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不接受。

sentences.en: And I could just see, I just, he's like, what, you know, he's really serious about this.
sentences.zh: 我能看出来，我就是，他那种，你知道的，他是真的很严肃对待这件事。

sentences.en: And I could just tell there was a shift.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到情况发生了转变。

sentences.en: There was not the optimism that I was detecting from him and his team a couple of weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 没有了我几周前从他及其团队身上察觉到的那种乐观情绪。

sentences.en: I could tell that he thought that these guys might not actually be serious about a deal
sentences.zh: 我能看出他认为这些家伙可能并不是真的想达成协议

sentences.en: and that this was potentially going in a different direction.
sentences.zh: 而这件事很可能会朝着不同的方向发展。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人那样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So Jonathan, last week you were on Air Force One with the president before the attacks had occurred.
sentences.zh: 那么乔纳森，上周在袭击发生前，你和总统一起在空军一号上。

sentences.en: And you start getting the sense that something might be shifting, there might be something in the works.
sentences.zh: 你开始感觉到情况可能有所转变，可能有什么事情正在酝酿中。

sentences.en: Can you walk us through what you learn next?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们讲讲你接下来了解到了什么吗？

sentences.en: So the next day, it's a Saturday, we learn that Trump has changed his schedule.
sentences.zh: 所以第二天，也就是星期六，我们得知特朗普改变了行程。

sentences.en: We were expecting to fly back on Air Force One to Washington on Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我们原本预计周日下午乘坐空军一号飞回华盛顿。

sentences.en: And we get this notice from the White House saying he's actually going to go to Camp
sentences.zh: 然后我们接到白宫的通知，说他实际上要在周日去戴维

sentences.en: David on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 营。

sentences.en: And that was very curious to me because Donald Trump does not voluntarily go to
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常奇怪，因为唐纳德·特朗普在新泽西打完周末高尔夫后，周六晚上去了UFC比赛，他可不会主动去

sentences.en: Camp David after a weekend playing golf in New Jersey, went to the UFC on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 戴维营。

sentences.en: He doesn't like Camp David.
sentences.zh: 他不喜欢戴维营。

sentences.en: It's a very rustic, you know, wooded retreat.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是一个非常简朴、树木丛生的静修地。

sentences.en: So that made me think, well, something's up.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，嗯，有情况。

sentences.en: And I still didn't know I was making phone calls, talking to sources.
sentences.zh: 当时我依然不知道，我一直在打电话，跟消息人士交流。

sentences.en: I actually, at that point, couldn't establish what was happening.
sentences.zh: 实际上，在那时我无法确定究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: But what we've learned in the last week reporting with my colleagues, Maggie Haberman, Mark Mazzetti, Ronan Bergman, and others,
sentences.zh: 但我们在过去一周通过与我的同事玛吉·哈伯曼、马克·马祖蒂、罗南·伯格曼及其他人的报道中了解到的是，

sentences.en: is that John Ratcliffe, the CIA director, and Dan Cain, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, gave a presentation.
sentences.zh: 中情局局长约翰·拉特克利夫和参谋长联席会议主席丹·凯恩做了一场简报。

sentences.en: It lasted about two and a half hours.
sentences.zh: 持续了大约两个半小时。

sentences.en: And Ratcliffe laid out the CIA's assessment that it was highly likely that Netanyahu was moving ahead with this military operation with or without American participation.
sentences.zh: 拉特克利夫陈述了中情局的评估，即内塔尼亚威无论有没有美国参与，都极有可能推进这项军事行动。

sentences.en: But they still don't have a briefing.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍然没有拿到作战简报。

sentences.en: It's not like the Israeli said, here are our war plans.
sentences.zh: 并不是说以色列人说过，这是我们的作战计划。

sentences.en: Here's what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这是我们要做的。

sentences.en: The next day, any remaining doubts are dispelled.
sentences.zh: 第二天，所有残存的疑虑都烟消云散了。

sentences.en: Trump has a phone call with Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 特朗普与内塔尼亚威通了电话。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu is unequivocal.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚威的态度毫不含糊。

sentences.en: They're doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们要动手了。

sentences.en: The mission is a go.
sentences.zh: 任务批准执行。

sentences.en: And he gives Trump a pretty high-level overview of what they're doing, talks about some of the aspects of the military campaign.
sentences.zh: 他向特朗普大致介绍了他们要做的事情，谈到了军事行动的一些方面。

sentences.en: And Trump did not exert substantial counter-pressure.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普并没有施加实质性的反向压力。

sentences.en: He did not, as far as we've been able to ascertain, lean in to do not do this.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他并没有倾向于说“不要这样做”。

sentences.en: You should not do this.
sentences.zh: “你们不应该这样做。”

sentences.en: The message the Israelis had after that was there's no daylight between us.
sentences.zh: 以色列人之后的反应是，我们之间没有任何分歧。

sentences.en: And after that call, he said to some of his advisers, we might have to help them with this.
sentences.zh: 在那通电话之后，他对一些顾问说，我们可能得在这件事上帮帮他们。

sentences.en: So how does Trump decide to have America participate in that initial attack on Iran?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普是如何决定让美国参与对伊朗最初的那次袭击的呢？

sentences.en: Well, we don't actually know that yet, interestingly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说实话，我们目前还不知道。

sentences.en: He authorized certain support from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他授权了来自美国

sentences.en: intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 情报界的某些支持。

sentences.en: And because of the nature of national secrets, we still haven't got the full picture of what America has done so far.
sentences.zh: 由于国家机密的性质，我们至今仍未完全了解美国迄今为止所做的一切。

sentences.en: But it's not nothing.
sentences.zh: 但这并非无足轻重。

sentences.en: And at a minimum, it's intelligence sharing.
sentences.zh: 至少，这是情报共享。

sentences.en: But I expect that we'll find out that it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 但我预计我们会发现，情况远不止于此。

sentences.en: But he's still telling people, I think, I told him not to do it.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然对人们说，我想，我告诉过他不要这么做。

sentences.en: Even on the day of the strikes, he was very, very ambivalent and was still eager to see if they could get a deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 甚至在空袭当天，他的态度也非常非常矛盾，依然急切地想看看能否与伊朗达成协议。

sentences.en: He's still trying to put a little bit of distance between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他仍在试图在这场袭击中与美国

sentences.en: and Israel on this attack.
sentences.zh: 和以色列保持一点距离。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: And you saw that.
sentences.zh: 你也看到了。

sentences.en: I mean, that evening when the bombs start flying, it's about eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那天晚上炸弹开始落下时，大约是八点钟。

sentences.en: Trump has just been at the congressional picnic.
sentences.zh: 特朗普刚刚参加完国会野餐。

sentences.en: He goes down to the White House Situation Room.
sentences.zh: 他走下白宫战情室。

sentences.en: They're all watching this unfold, getting intelligence updates.
sentences.zh: 他们都在看着事态发展，获取情报更新。

sentences.en: And everyone's wondering, when's Trump going to make a statement?
sentences.zh: 每个人都在想，特朗普什么时候会发表声明？

sentences.en: What's he going to say?
sentences.zh: 他会说些什么？

sentences.en: And certainly in my memory, anytime Israel's at war, U.S.
sentences.zh: 在我的记忆中，每当以色列处于战争状态时，美国

sentences.en: stands with Israel, right?
sentences.zh: 总是坚定支持以色列，对吧？

sentences.en: And the administration put out a pretty extraordinary statement.
sentences.zh: 然而政府发表了一份非常不同寻常的声明。

sentences.en: Its first statement that it put out was from the Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
sentences.zh: 它发布的第一个声明来自国务卿马可·鲁比奥。

sentences.en: Nowhere in that statement did it say, we stand with Israel.
sentences.zh: 该声明中通篇没有说“我们与以色列站在一起”。

sentences.en: In fact, the entire statement was basically built around distancing the United
sentences.zh: 事实上，整个声明基本上都围绕着将美国

sentences.en: States from this military operation and warning around, do not go after us, America.
sentences.zh: 与这次军事行动拉开距离，并警告对方不要把矛头指向我们美国。

sentences.en: So even though we know that secretly they were helping in certain ways that are not completely clear to us yet,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管我们知道他们暗中以某种我们尚不完全清楚的方式提供了帮助，

sentences.en: publicly they were distancing themselves.
sentences.zh: 但在公开场合，他们却在与此保持距离。

sentences.en: And Trump said nothing for at least a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在至少几个小时内一言不发。

sentences.en: He just was uncharacteristically silent.
sentences.zh: 他一反常态地保持着沉默。

sentences.en: They basically wanted people to think they had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是想让人们以为这与他们毫无关系。

sentences.en: That was what they were projecting and putting out there.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们当时所展现和释放出的姿态。

sentences.en: But as the night unfolded, and certainly that first wave of attacks appeared stunningly successful.
sentences.zh: 但随着夜幕降临，第一波袭击显然取得了惊人的成功。

sentences.en: Israel was doing precision strikes, killing Iranian military leaders, hitting strategic sites.
sentences.zh: 以色列进行了精确打击，击毙了伊朗军事领导人，打击了战略目标。

sentences.en: People around Trump were like, oh, this is actually pretty impressive.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身边的觉得，哦，这其实相当令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And Trump's favorite TV channel, Fox News, is broadcasting wall-to-wall on Israel's military genius.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普最喜欢的电视频道福克斯新闻，正在全天候播报以色列的军事天才之举。

sentences.en: And it was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有意思。

sentences.en: You could see it happen in real time.
sentences.zh: 你能亲眼看到这一切实时发生。

sentences.en: Trump basically thinking, I need some credit here.
sentences.zh: 特朗普基本上在想，我在这里得捞点功劳。

sentences.en: And the next morning, he does this series of phone calls with different reporters where he's saying this is excellent, this operation is brilliant,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他与几位记者进行了一系列通话，表示这非常出色，这次行动堪称辉煌，

sentences.en: and hinting that he had much more to do with it than people realized, starting to take ownership of it publicly.
sentences.zh: 并暗示他在其中的作用比人们意识到的要大得多，开始公开将功劳揽在自己身上。

sentences.en: Because it's being hailed as a success.
sentences.zh: 因为这件事被欢呼为一次成功。

sentences.en: I can't get inside his motivations, but those two things are true, right?
sentences.zh: 我无法揣测他的动机，但这两点都是事实，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, this looked like a great success, and Donald Trump starts claiming credit for it, whereas, you know, just hours earlier, they were distancing themselves from it.
sentences.zh: 比如，这看起来像是一场巨大的成功，于是唐纳德·特朗普开始为此居功至伟，然而就在几小时前，他们还在刻意与之保持距离。

sentences.en: And then we were hearing from sources that Trump was very seriously considering escalating America's involvement in a serious way.
sentences.zh: 然后我们从消息人士那里听到，特朗普正在非常认真地考虑以一种重大方式升级美国的介入。

sentences.en: So we can start to see his position about what the United States involvement should be shifting in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以开始看到他对美国应该扮演何种角色的立场在实时发生转变。

sentences.en: And very quickly, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来速度非常快。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Sunday night, he flies to Canada for the G7.
sentences.zh: 所以周日晚上，他飞往加拿大参加七国集团峰会。

sentences.en: He's there on Monday.
sentences.zh: 他周一在那里。

sentences.en: And then he cuts his trip short and really starts to signal that he was now moving towards potential military options.
sentences.zh: 然后他缩短了行程，并真正开始发出信号，表明他现在正转向潜在的军事选项。

sentences.en: So he says, you know, people are saying, I want to go back to DC to work on a ceasefire to between Israel and
sentences.zh: 所以他说，你知道的，人们都在说，我想回华盛顿去努力达成一项以色列与

sentences.en: Iran.
sentences.zh: 伊朗之间的停火协议。

sentences.en: Wrong.
sentences.zh: 大错特错。

sentences.en: They have no idea.
sentences.zh: 他们根本一无所知。

sentences.en: It's much bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 事情远比这要重大得多。

sentences.en: It's fake news that I'm doing peace talks, fake news.
sentences.zh: 说我在进行和平谈判纯属假新闻，全是假新闻。

sentences.en: And then his messages start to get more and more menacing, to the point where today,
sentences.zh: 接着他的言论开始变得越来越具有威胁性，直到今天——

sentences.en: we're recording this on Tuesday afternoon, but earlier today, Trump posts, I mean, it is extraordinary that we're watching a commander in chief do this in real time.
sentences.zh: 我们是在周二下午录制这期节目，但就在今天早些时候，特朗普发帖称——我是说，我们正在实时目睹一位三军统帅做出这样的举动，这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: He posts, we now have complete and total control of the skies over Iran.
sentences.zh: 他发帖称，我们现在已经完全且彻底地控制了伊朗上空的天空。

sentences.en: And the next message, he's directly threatening the supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 而在下一条信息中，他直接对最高领袖发出了威胁。

sentences.en: He says, we know exactly where the supreme leader is hiding.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们清楚地知道最高领袖藏在哪里。

sentences.en: He's an easy target.
sentences.zh: 他是个显眼的靶子。

sentences.en: We're not going to take him out, at least not for now, but you better not shoot missiles at civilians or American soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我们不会除掉他，至少现在不会，但你最好别向平民或美国士兵发射导弹。

sentences.en: And then his next message is just all caps, unconditional surrender.
sentences.zh: 然后他的下一条信息全是大写字母：无条件投降。

sentences.en: So people around Trump that I've spoken to believe that he's already made the decision to drop this bomb.
sentences.zh: 因此，据我同特朗普身边的人交谈了解，他们认为他已经做出了投掷这枚炸弹的决定。

sentences.en: I don't know if he has or he hasn't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他究竟做没做出决定。

sentences.en: I've given up on trying to put declarative statements around Donald Trump's decision making.
sentences.zh: 我已经放弃试图去对特朗普的决策过程做出绝对化的断言了。

sentences.en: Of course, he could change his mind.
sentences.zh: 当然，他随时可能改变主意。

sentences.en: But that's where things stand right now.
sentences.zh: 但目前的情况就是这样。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure I'm clear on this, Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，我只是想确认一下我的理解是否准确。

sentences.en: So it is possible that we might see these 30,000 pound bombs being dropped at some time in the not so distant future on this nuclear
sentences.zh: 所以，在并不算太遥远的未来，我们确实有可能看到这些三万磅重的炸弹被投放到

sentences.en: enrichment facility that's buried deep underground.
sentences.zh: 这座深埋于地下的核浓缩设施上吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the one thing we do know from our reporting is that he is seriously considering actually leaning toward was what we wrote in our
sentences.zh: 而根据我们的报道，我们确实知道的一点是，他正在认真考虑——实际上倾向于我们文章中写的内容——

sentences.en: article based on some of the comments he's been making to people bombing Fordow, the deep underground nuclear site in Iran.
sentences.zh: 根据他向人们发表的一些言论，即轰炸伊朗深层地下核设施福尔多。

sentences.en: To what extent is the moment that we're in now a result of Trump changing his mind about the likelihood that a negotiation would produce a deal versus this being a story about
sentences.zh: 我们现在所处的这个时刻，在多大程度上是因为特朗普改变了对谈判达成协议可能性的看法，还是说这个故事实际上关乎

sentences.en: how Benjamin Netanyahu figured out a way to bring Trump onto his side, maybe even without Trump's willing participation at times.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡是如何找到办法把特朗普拉到他这一边的，甚至有时可能是在特朗普并非完全心甘情愿的情况下？

sentences.en: In other words, is this a story of Benjamin Netanyahu basically outmaneuvering Trump into this?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这究竟是不是一个本雅明·内塔尼亚胡基本上通过高超策略把特朗普逼入这一境地的故事？

sentences.en: I think that's part of the story for sure.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是其中一部分。

sentences.en: But I don't think it's as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为事情没那么简单。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was always of the view that Iran could not have a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普一直认为伊朗绝不能拥有核武器。

sentences.en: He was never as isolationist, anti-interventionist, pick your adjective, as some of his supporters wanted him to be.
sentences.zh: 他从来不像他的一些支持者所希望的那样，是一个孤立主义者、反干涉主义者，随便你怎么称呼他。

sentences.en: So I do think that Donald Trump was left in a position where he was not driving events.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为，唐纳德·特朗普最终处于一种并未主导事态发展的位置。

sentences.en: So in that sense, you could say, yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，你可以说，完全正确。

sentences.en: Netanyahu was driving this train.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在驱动这列火车。

sentences.en: Trump was reacting to events.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普只是在对事态作出反应。

sentences.en: And the fear, of course, has always been that if Israel hit Iran in this way, and particularly if the United States got involved in the way that you have reported
sentences.zh: 当然，一直以来的担忧在于，如果以色列以这种方式打击伊朗，特别是如果美国也以你所报道的那种方式卷入其中——

sentences.en: Trump is considering getting involved, that it could spiral out of control in some fashion and engulf the entire region into another war.
sentences.zh: 即特朗普正考虑介入的方式，这可能会以某种形式失控，并将整个地区卷入又一场战争。

sentences.en: And as you said, Trump is a passenger on this train with Netanyahu in the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，特朗普只是这列火车上的乘客，而内塔尼亚胡则坐在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: The fact is, no matter what messaging Trump or the White House put out, America is now engaged in a war.
sentences.zh: 事实是，无论特朗普或白宫发表什么言论，美国现在都已经卷入了一场战争。

sentences.en: Right now, at 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 就在此时，周二下午5点，

sentences.en: on Tuesday, it's a fairly limited engagement.
sentences.zh: 这还只是一场相当有限的交战。

sentences.en: But if Donald Trump drops the bunker buster bomb, the door has opened to a much larger range of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 但如果唐纳德·特朗普投下了巨型钻地弹，那就等同于开启了通往范围大得多的各种可能性的大门。

sentences.en: I have to say, Jonathan, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，乔纳森，如果美国

sentences.en: gets involved in another war in the
sentences.zh: 再次卷入中东的一场战争，而其中存在着这样一个巨大疑问：即一个国家究竟有没有大规模杀伤性武器，

sentences.en: Middle East where there's this big question of whether or not a country has a weapon of mass
sentences.zh: 并且政权更迭至少已经被提上议事日程，

sentences.en: destruction, where regime change is at least on the table, that's going to sound very, very familiar to people who lived through the Iraq war.
sentences.zh: 这对于经历过伊拉克战争的人来说，听上去会感到非常非常熟悉。

sentences.en: And I think, understandably, people are going to have a lot of questions about whether the United States should be involved at all, just given our collective experience.
sentences.zh: 我想，可以理解的是，鉴于我们共同的经历，人们会对美国是否应该介入产生许多疑问。

sentences.en: And I just sort of wonder what you think about that feeling.
sentences.zh: 我只是有点好奇你对这种情绪有什么看法。

sentences.en: Well, it's a very understandable feeling.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一种非常可以理解的情绪。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has made clear, even in the last few days, that he has no desire or interest in sending American troops into Iran and engaging a ground force.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普甚至在过去几天里也已经明确表示，他完全没有意愿或兴趣向伊朗派遣美军并投入地面部队。

sentences.en: And he certainly hopes, I believe, that this will be a matter of dropping a bomb and staying
sentences.zh: 而且我相信他当然希望，这仅仅是一次投下炸弹然后抽身的事，

sentences.en: out, letting Israel take care of the reSt. And maybe it turns out like that, but maybe it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 让以色列去处理剩下的事情。也许结果会如他所愿，但也可能不会。

sentences.en: And unfortunately for Trump, he doesn't have the only vote in deciding that.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是对特朗普而言，在决定这件事上并不只有他手里的一票。

sentences.en: Netanyahu drove this war.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡推动了这场战争。

sentences.en: He drove towards this military campaign.
sentences.zh: 他一路推动着走向这场军事行动。

sentences.en: And Iran has a vote too.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗同样也有一票。

sentences.en: And America has bases in the region and a lot of soft targets here at home that,
sentences.zh: 并且美国在该地区设有基地，在国内也有许多容易遭受攻击的目标，

sentences.en: God forbid, Iran might try to strike.
sentences.zh: 如果真发生不幸的话，伊朗可能会试图对这些目标发动打击。

sentences.en: So we are heading down a cycle of uncertainty that we're going to have to confront.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们正走向一个必须去直面的充满不确定性的循环。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来参加节目。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
